script: A man once sold thousands of people land in a country that didn't exist, and made them pay for the trip there themselves. In 1822, Gregor MacGregor told London investors he was a prince ruling a rich Central American nation called Poyais. He sold land, printed fake currency, and sent settlers across the ocean to build new lives there. When they arrived, there was no capital, no government, just empty jungle. Almost a third of them died before rescue ships found the survivors. MacGregor was arrested back in London, and walked free on a technicality. A man once invented an entire country, and got away with it completely.

title: A Man Once Sold an Entire Country That Didn't Exist
description:
In 1822, Gregor MacGregor convinced London investors and settlers that a rich nation called Poyais existed in Central America. It didn't. Almost a third of the settlers died before rescue.
